subject: Important Update: Changes to Account Security Measures
body: Dear Valued Customer, We are writing to inform you about some important changes to our account security measures. In order to enhance the protection of your personal information, we have implemented new security protocols that require all users to update their passwords with a stronger combination of characters. Please log in to your account and follow the prompts to create a new password. Your security is our top priority, and we appreciate your cooperation in this matter. Thank you for being a loyal customer. Best regards, The Security Team
